reviews.text:
Amazing cut on my 2 x Pomeranians
Friendly and great communication
Will be back … thanks Suzy

Jack had his very first groom with Suzy and she did a wonderful job! She was so kind, patient and gentle with him, and he came back looking absolutely amazing.

Her salon in Longbridge is lovely and welcoming, and you can really tell how much she cares about the dogs she looks after. We couldn’t have asked for a better first grooming experience for Jack. Highly recommend Suzy!

Suzy is an excellent dog groomer. We have 2 dogs that see Suzy regularly and one of them is very nervy, but he loves and trusts her so so much.
Both of the dogs have such a lovely bond with her and she cuts them perfectly each and every time!

Took cockapoo  to Suzy’s today for a groom. I pick her up she has been shaved like a lamb with bald patches all over  ears scalped. Was told hair was matted wot all over !!!!!
Won’t be using again very very disappointed

As always I was nervous trying a new groomer after a bad experience however Akira had been an absolute Angel! She's amazing with my super nervous dog and younger pup! Can really tell she loves animals! Highly recommend her
Molly has been groomed by suzy many times always excellent today was first time at her shop and it was as good as ever molly came out looking and smelling  beautiful excellent work by suzy

First time going into Suzy’s just for nail clipping for Bruno 🙂 wow what can I say such caring and accommodating people the salon is lovely and clean deffo be going back and I will never change one very happy customer…. Suzy you are stuck with myself & Bruno …
I’m delighted with Ralphie, my cocker spaniels, hair cut. Very smart.Great location, 4 mins from the biggest M&S food and clothes store in Rubery.

Just took my cockapoo Luna for her first groom with Suzy after being highly recommended.Suzy is such a lovely lady,really easy to speak to.the salon is in a great location with parking available and inside the grooming salon was clean,cute and inviting with a lovely calming atmosphere.my dog has come out beautiful and pleased to say will be returning.cannot recommend highly enough
Thankyou Suzy ! X

Fabulous groom for our Shih Tzu, came back looking so clean and smelt lovely for days, first time there and booking next one in.

Thank you

Suzy has previously groomed our scottish terriers Rupert and Blossom, so when we got our new scottie Olive, there was no one else we would want to groom her.  Olive is nearly one, and during the past years, Suzy has groomed Olive's scottie skirt and beard to perfection 👌 we regularly get stopped by people who comment on her cut.  We wouldn't take Olive anywhere else and highly recommend Suzy 😀  Jacqui & Paul

I wouldn’t take my baby boy anywhere else! Suzy’s knowledge of breed-specific styles and cuts is incredible, and Cooper is completely at ease with her, he absolutely loves his visits. The shop itself is fantastic: secure, welcoming, and so comfortable for the dogs. You can really tell how much care and thought has gone into every detail.

This was our first puppy groom, I was very nervous but Suzy kept in touch before the appointment and answered all my questions. I couldn't wish for a more helpful groomer. On the day, the place was immaculate, Suzy is so friendly and I was so relieved to see our nervous puppy relax like she was at home. She absolutely loved Suzy so I felt at ease. The cut was just perfect. I am absolutely delighted with the end result and our pup couldn't be happier. Such a positive experience I can't wait to visit again. Thank you so much, I cannot recommend enough.
Willow had Suzy groom her for the first time today. Suzy was so friendly and professional and Willow came out looking beautiful definitely recommend.

We've been bringing our beloved poodle, Disco, to Suzy for over two years now, and we truly couldn't imagine entrusting his care to anyone else. From adorable teddy bear cuts to intricate Asian fusion styles and the classic poodle groom, Suzy has delivered it all with precision, creativity, and love. Each groom is done to the highest standard, and Disco always comes home looking absolutely fabulous and smelling heavenly.

Her new studio is just as impressive as her grooming skills—beautifully designed, spotless, and fully equipped with top-of-the-line tools and premium fur care products. It’s clear she’s thought of everything to ensure a safe, calming, and professional environment for both pets and their people. The transition from van to salon has been seamless as she let us come and look (and sniff!) around beforehand.

But most importantly, we trust Suzy completely with our baby. Disco adores her, and it’s easy to see why—her kindness, skill, and genuine love for animals shine through in every visit. Suzy is a true gem, and we feel incredibly lucky to have her as part of Disco’s life. If you’re looking for the perfect groomer for your beloved dog, look no further.
Lily’s first time at Suzy’s. She’s a nervous little thing but Suzy was great with her. She came back looking and smelling beautiful. The salon is clean and bright and smells amazing.
Took my nervous dog to Suzy. She worked wonders with him. He was relaxed and came home looking and smelling great 😊 …

Clean, modern and kind.. Suzy does a wonderful job and R comes back happy, smelling gorgeous and looking amazing. He is an uncommon breed with an unusual breed standard cut and Suzy does a brilliant job! Thank you.
